findings.title: Write path never rechecks cache and can clear a good entry
findings.body: In pkg/api/webassets/webassets.go, GetWebAssets drops its read lock and at line 48 takes entryPointAssetsCacheMu for the entire load (the assets-manifest file read, and readWebAssetsFromCDN if that branch runs) without reading entryPointAssetsCache again. Every caller that saw a nil cache therefore repeats that I/O while holding the write lock, so concurrent startup or dev calls serialize and the read-fast path blocks behind them. Line 69 then always stores the result, including when the load failed and result is nil. A caller that loses the race to a successful load can overwrite the published cache with nil and return an error even though assets were already loaded. After the write lock is acquired, return the existing pointer when Env is not Dev and the cache is non-nil, and only assign entryPointAssetsCache when the load succeeds.
